newsitem.title: USA: Macronix files with US SEC for bond offer.
newsitem.headline: Macronix files with US SEC for bond offer.

text.p: Macronix International Co. Ltd. filed on Tuesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an offering of $200 million of convertible bonds due 2007.
The Taiwan-based semiconductor company said proceeds from the sale will be used to fund part of the purchase of equipment for a new facility in Hsinchu.
Underwriters Credit Suisse First Boston, Jardine Fleming and Morgan Stanley & Co. Inc. have an option to buy up to an additional $30 million, principal amount, of bonds, it said.
